name: GEWA Global Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own top prize; its only complete, dated 1997 defence in this collection's holdings was written inside another alliance's own shared broadcast rather than the fed's own card.

name: GEWA Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by an explicit Neo-Nazi-gimmick stable, The Fourth Reich, as of December 1997 -- content note carried on the wing's own face per the no-taste-rulings gavel.
notes: No won-date recovered; the team is billed as champions in the 11 Dec 1997 broadcast with no earlier title-change document surviving.

name: GEWA Americas Championship
epitaph: Named only by a former champion's own billing (Red Raven, "a former GEWA Americas champion"); no title-change document survives in this collection's holdings.

name: GEWA Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Named only by an outside billing; no title-change document survives.
